title: Expanding the Cardano C++ SDK: libcardano

ms.promise:
・Stake pool cold key generation and serialization (use Viper25519). Include the ability to generate the cold key counter used when generating KES keys. Open source code pushed to the public repository including passing test cases. New documentation auto built and published to the project website.
・Expand the current ledger data types to include stake pool certificates. The certificates will be serializable to CBOR for inclusion within transactions. Add the ability to generate and sign transactions containing a stake pool certificate. Open source code pushed to the public repository including passing test cases. New documentation auto built and published to the project website. 

Project repository: https://gitlab.com/viperscience/libcardano
ms.criteria:
・Working code and unit tests for: stake pool cold key generation (and counter). The new code is ready to be included in a separate project as part of the libcardano public API. The new functionality is documented in sufficient detail that a reader could re-implement the code.
・Working code and unit tests for: stake pool certificate generation, serialization, and inclusion in valid transactions. The new code is ready to be included in a separate project as part of the libcardano public API. The new functionality is documented in sufficient detail that a reader could re-implement the code.

ms.report:
We have successfully completed the addition of stake pool KES keys to the library.
・Added general implementation of the Sum KES method (fully templated to technically allow any depth).
・Moved the ed25519/VRF/KES functionality out of the Viper25519 library and into libcardano. Pulled in some ed25519 functionality from libsodium and crypto++.
・Add Stake Pool KES key objects (Depth=6) and serialization capability.
・Unit test based on KES test vector from the Rust and Haskell implementations.
・Updated project documentation!
